name: LEARN Afghan
description: LEARN provides free Pashto- and Dari-language education for Grades 1–12, reaching millions via online schools and offline apps in STEM subjects, coding, biophysics, and more. They operate digital schools and community centers across provinces like Kandahar, Herat, and Samangan and deliver humanitarian support—including food aid, menstrual health training, and maternal care—while empowering girls and youth through digital skills and leadership development.
